import json, subprocess, sys
PROG="/app/submission/scheduler.py"
def run(raw):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B",PROG], input=raw if isinstance(raw,bytes) else raw.encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

base_stream = {"mode":"stream","banks":2,"lanes":2,"limit":20,"borders":[0,10,20],
               "capacity":1,"epoch":2,"steps":[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1}]}]}
base_burst = {"mode":"burst","banks":2,"lanes":2,"limit":20,"borders":[0,10,20],
              "start_bank":0,"packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1}]}

cases = []
def add(name, obj_or_raw):
    cases.append((name, obj_or_raw))

# --- structural / JSON-level
add("not json", b"{hello")
add("trailing data", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]} x')
add("trailing newline ok?", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}\n\n')
add("top-level list", b'[1,2,3]')
add("top-level int", b'5')
add("empty input", b'')
add("whitespace only", b'   \n ')
add("dup key", b'{"mode":"burst","mode":"stream","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')
add("dup nested key", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[{"id":"a","id":"a","lane":0,"rank":0}]}')
add("NaN", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":NaN,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')
add("Infinity", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":Infinity,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')
add("-Infinity limit", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":-Infinity,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')
add("float banks", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":2.0,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')
add("float rank", json.dumps({**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1.0}]}).encode())
add("exp float", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1e1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')
add("invalid utf8", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[{"id":"\xff","lane":0,"rank":0}]}')
add("bom", b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')
add("deep nesting 13", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[[[[[[[[[[[[[]]]]]]]]]]]]]}')
add("deep nesting 12 ok", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[[[[[[[[[[[[]]]]]]]]]]]]}')
add("huge int", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":' + b'9'*5000 + b'}]}')
add("null value", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":null,"lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')
add("string number", b'{"mode":"burst","banks":"1","lanes":1,"limit":1,"borders":[0,1],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')

# --- field sets
for extra in ("capacity", "epoch", "steps", "start_bank", "packets", "foo"):
    d = dict(base_burst); d[extra] = 0
    add("burst extra field "+extra, d)
for miss in ("mode","banks","lanes","limit","borders","start_bank","packets"):
    d = dict(base_burst); del d[miss]
    add("burst missing "+miss, d)
for miss in ("mode","banks","lanes","limit","borders","capacity","epoch","steps"):
    d = dict(base_stream); del d[miss]
    add("stream missing "+miss, d)
d = dict(base_stream); d["start_bank"]=0
add("stream extra start_bank", d)
add("bad mode", {**base_burst, "mode":"Stream"})
add("mode bool", {**base_burst, "mode":True})
add("mode missing", {k:v for k,v in base_burst.items() if k!="mode"})

# --- ranges
add("banks 0", {**base_burst, "banks":0})
add("banks 17", {**base_burst, "banks":17})
add("banks bool", {**base_burst, "banks":True})
add("banks float", {**base_burst, "banks":2.5})
add("lanes 0", {**base_burst, "lanes":0})
add("lanes 9", {**base_burst, "lanes":9})
add("limit 0", {**base_burst, "limit":0, "borders":[0]})
add("limit too big", {**base_burst, "limit":2147483649, "borders":[0,2147483649]})
add("borders not list", {**base_burst, "borders":"0,10,20"})
add("borders empty", {**base_burst, "borders":[], "limit":0})
add("borders single", {**base_burst, "borders":[0], "limit":0})
add("borders not increasing", {**base_burst, "borders":[0,20,10]})
add("borders equal", {**base_burst, "borders":[0,10,10,20]})
add("borders start not 0", {**base_burst, "borders":[1,10,20]})
add("borders end not limit", {**base_burst, "borders":[0,10,19]})
add("borders R=33", {**base_burst, "limit":33, "borders":list(range(34))})
add("borders float", {**base_burst, "borders":[0,10.0,20]})
add("borders bool", {**base_burst, "borders":[0,True,20]})

# --- packets
add("packet extra field", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1,"x":1}]})
add("packet missing field", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0}]})
add("packet not obj", {**base_burst, "packets":["a"]})
add("id too long", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a"*33,"lane":0,"rank":1}]})
add("id 33 chars", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a"*32,"lane":0,"rank":1}]})
add("id bad char", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a.b","lane":0,"rank":1}]})
add("id empty", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"","lane":0,"rank":1}]})
add("id space", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a b","lane":0,"rank":1}]})
add("id unicode", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"é","lane":0,"rank":1}]})
add("id not str", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":5,"lane":0,"rank":1}]})
add("dup id in burst", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1},{"id":"a","lane":1,"rank":2}]})
add("lane out of range", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":2,"rank":1}]})
add("lane negative", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":-1,"rank":1}]})
add("lane bool", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":True,"rank":1}]})
add("rank out of range", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":20}]})
add("rank negative", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":-1}]})
add("rank bool", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":True}]})
add("packets not list", {**base_burst, "packets":{}})
add("packets 120001", {**base_burst, "packets":[{"id":"p%d"%i,"lane":0,"rank":1} for i in range(120001)]})
add("start_bank out of range", {**base_burst, "start_bank":2})
add("start_bank negative", {**base_burst, "start_bank":-1})
add("start_bank bool", {**base_burst, "start_bank":False})
add("start_bank float", {**base_burst, "start_bank":0.0})

# --- stream specifics
add("capacity 0", {**base_stream, "capacity":0})
add("capacity 20001", {**base_stream, "capacity":20001})
add("epoch -1", {**base_stream, "epoch":-1})
add("epoch 40001", {**base_stream, "epoch":40001})
add("steps not list", {**base_stream, "steps":{}})
add("steps 40001", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":i,"serve":False,"arrivals":[]} for i in range(40001)]})
add("step extra field", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[],"x":1}]})
add("step missing field", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0,"serve":True}]})
add("step not obj", {**base_stream, "steps":[1]})
add("t negative", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":-1,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]}]})
add("t too big", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":9007199254740992,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]}]})
add("t max ok", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":9007199254740991,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]}]})
add("t not increasing", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":5,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]},{"t":5,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]}]})
add("t decreasing", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":5,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]},{"t":4,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]}]})
add("t float", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0.5,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]}]})
add("serve int", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0,"serve":1,"arrivals":[]}]})
add("serve null", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0,"serve":None,"arrivals":[]}]})
add("arrivals not list", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":{}}]})
add("arrivals too many", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1},{"id":"b","lane":1,"rank":1},{"id":"c","lane":2,"rank":1}]}]})
add("arrivals dup lane", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1},{"id":"b","lane":0,"rank":2}]}]})
add("arrivals dup id across steps", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0,"serve":False,"arrivals":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1}]},{"t":1,"serve":False,"arrivals":[{"id":"a","lane":1,"rank":1}]}]})
add("120001 attempts", {**base_stream, "lanes":8, "steps":[{"t":i,"serve":False,"arrivals":[{"id":"p%d"%j,"lane":l,"rank":1} for l in range(8)]} for i in range(15001)][:15000] + [{"t":99999,"serve":False,"arrivals":[{"id":"x%d"%j,"lane":0,"rank":1}]}]})

# expected-valid controls
add("valid stream empty steps", {**base_stream, "steps":[]})
add("valid burst empty packets", {**base_burst, "packets":[]})
add("valid stream empty arrivals", {**base_stream, "steps":[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]}]})

fails = 0
for name, obj in cases:
    rc, out, err = run(obj)
    is_err = (rc == 2 and out == b'{"error":"invalid input"}\n')
    ok_names = ("ok", "valid", "whitespace", "deep nesting 12 ok", "t max ok", "id 33 chars")
    expect_valid = any(k in name for k in ok_names)
    if expect_valid:
        good = (rc == 0 and out.startswith(b'{') and b'"error"' not in out)
    else:
        good = is_err and err == b''
    if not good:
        fails += 1
        print("BAD:", name, "rc", rc, "out", out[:80], "err", err[:200])
print("total cases", len(cases), "failures", fails)
PYEOF
python3 invalids.py
